context: RequestCounter tracks per-endpoint hit counts. A single instance is shared across all HTTP handler goroutines via middleware.
explanation: The counts map is read and written from concurrent goroutines with no synchronization — map operations in Go are not safe for concurrent use and will cause a fatal "concurrent map read and map write" panic at runtime. Fix: protect the map with a sync.Mutex or sync.RWMutex, or use sync.Map.
